name: capsule26
description: A design pattern for letting code outside the agent's reach enforce balance, tier, session budget and policy violations for an autonomous AI agent. Append-only ledger, a runway-based tier system that degrades as money runs low, and a session-budget circuit breaker — dependency-free Python. Includes 4 skills: agent-approval-gate, agent-budget-guardrail, agent-retry-safety, agentkeeper.
